findings.title: Docs in the diff report a stale count of helper tests as the current local result
findings.detail: `publication-candidate.md` says 'Local verification passed 45 helper controls and 10 existing controller controls', and the 'Current repair, 2026-10-28' section of `local-verification.md` says the same. At this head, `scripts/pr-gates/tests` contains 53 tests: `test_plan` has 20 and `test_evidence` has 33. The PR body reports 53. The issue requires reporting validation with isolated controls, and these documents present an outdated number as current.
findings.required_fix: Change the current-validation counts in `publication-candidate.md` and the 'Current repair' section of `local-verification.md` to the 53 helper and 10 controller controls that exist at this head. Alternatively, label the 45 figure as historical.
